design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — task 1 (condo_coverage_changes)

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[5, 4]. Root condo_ext_deductible_raise_credit takes 5 factors, prerequisite condo_ext_coverage_a_realignment_charge takes 4.

[Why a good test] The customer asks only to raise her deductible from 1,000 to 2,500. The desk must read in the deductible policy that the credit is worked out only after the declarations show Coverage A at or above the tier's minimum for the master policy type on file, see that the association's change to bare walls (recorded 2026-09-01) puts the Special Premier minimum at 100000 while Coverage A is 30000.00, and work out that the Coverage A realignment is the only write that brings that state about. It must price the realignment (flood companion, claims-free, payment record, billing share) and then the credit on the annual premium in force that now includes the realignment's full-year effect, with the loss-history, re-raise, tenure and late-payment shares and the monthly-EFT month-count share. The difficulty lives in the policy chain, the record reading and the arithmetic; each problem has one tool.

[Scope] Occupied by task 0: condo_ext_liability_raise_charge, condo_ext_unit_rental_charge, raise_liability_limit_70984c5d, add_unit_rental_endorsement_60a857ee. Claimed here: condo_ext_coverage_a_realignment_charge + raise_coverage_a_minimum_ec3d8a44 (agent), condo_ext_deductible_raise_credit + elect_deductible_raise_c9f31846 (user). This is the last task; the four policies and four tools are covered once each.

[Problem-tree card] root condo_ext_deductible_raise_credit (user). Edge -> condo_ext_coverage_a_realignment_charge: kind value_input, gate annual_in_force, form state, policy_source "The credit for a deductible raise is worked out only after the declarations show Coverage A at or above the tier's minimum for the master policy type on file." (affirmative direction: a figure is worked out only after what it rests on is in place; task 0's sentence uses the negated direction for a booking), condition coverage_a_limit >= tier minimum for master_policy_type, resolved_by raise_coverage_a_minimum_ec3d8a44 (agent). Four-point test: connective "only after"; record-visible state (Coverage A and master policy type on the declarations); no tool/id/code token; hard requirement at exact scope. The only write in this difficulty that sets Coverage A is the realignment tool. Derivation: sentence + records (bare_walls, 30000.00) + realignment rule ("... raises Coverage A to exactly that minimum") -> the realignment. False at opening: initial_state.condo_policies.2c9dfdc2-1f1a-4d6a-aef5-462778287d11.coverage_a_limit = 30000.0 with master_policy_type bare_walls. Deletion sensitivity (actual run): without the realignment the credit is 36.79 (annual in force 1460.00) instead of 42.65. Order: realignment (step 8) then deductible (step 10). user_scenario never names Coverage A or the realignment; tools validate nothing.

[Base-invariant card] endorsable_status: in_force. open_claim_freeze: the only claim CGC-22-341177 is closed (390d9b86-e078-480b-b22b-ee5bd67676bb). no_backdated_change: retired by each policy's declared overwrite pinning the effective date to the request day (2026-09-24 < 2027-05-01). condo_association_changes: the change is recorded (2026-09-01, bare_walls); the 45-day association change period runs through 2026-10-16 (inclusive counting of the period's last day per base) so the realignment on 2026-09-24 is inside it and no nonrenewal notice is due; its time gate applies only to a nonrenewal notice, so temporal_feasibility is []. Declared overwrite on condo_association_changes: base "to at least the new minimum" becomes "to exactly that minimum" for a realignment, an owner wanting more asking separately (pins coverage_value to one figure). condo_cancellation_and_reinstatement: policy_scope.

[Business-object card] Target: CG6-3542-0917 (2c9dfdc2-1f1a-4d6a-aef5-462778287d11) of Rosalind Vukovich-Adeyemi. Rows read: claim payment 5eaaab3c-f9fc-448d-8a0d-931448b6e644; deductible lowering 34f7c870-cc0b-430e-996b-8e6695d115e0 (prior term, excluded from the annual premium in force by the current-term window); 14 current-term billing rows including the returned draft 3be66d06-265a-4218-952a-ed6deeea25f4, the returned-payment fee and the late fee; FloodGuard 1bafbb12-f1f4-483a-90fa-3042bf336228. Excluded: the returned-payment fee from the late-fee count; the prior-term lowering from the annual premium in force.

[Factor card] Realignment (base 3.58 x 70 x 219/365 = baseline 150.36): flood_companion 63 months -> 0.93 (alone at baseline 145.82), cross-difficulty flood; realignment_claims_free 54 months -> 0.95 (142.75); realignment_payment_record returned draft -> 1.05 (129.16); realignment_billing_share monthly EFT 7 of 12 unbilled -> 7/12 (139.49). Gold 135.61 (annual 232.48). Deductible (base 1692.48 x 0.10 x 219/365 = baseline 101.55): deductible_loss_history one payment in 60 months -> 0.80 (53.31); deductible_reraise lowering 18 months ago -> 0.50 (85.30); deductible_tenure 88 months -> 1.05 (40.62); deductible_late_payment one late fee -> 0.90 (47.39); deductible_billing_share monthly EFT -> (7+1)/12 (38.39). Gold 42.65 (annual 63.98). Near-misses: the returned-payment fee (not a late fee); the prior-term lowering (not in the annual premium in force).

[Seed rationale] customer; condo policy (association change recorded, Coverage A below minimum, monthly EFT, balance 0.00 = ledger: billed 608.31 + fees 25.00 + returned 121.67 = paid 754.98); 14 billing rows; 1 endorsement (2025 lowering); 3 claim rows; 1 FloodGuard policy on the unit since 2021 (FloodGuard Standard, zone AE, no elevation certificate, building 150000.00 within the tier's 100000-500000, contents 40000.00, deductibles 1000/1000 from the tier's options, replacement cost 180000.00 so the building limit is at least the tier's 80 percent, bound 2021-05-27 + 14 waiting days = 2021-06-10, term premium 485.79 = (150 x 2.96 x 1.04 + 40 x 1.24) = 511.36 less the 5 percent companion discount for the live CondoGuard at the same address, rounded, above the 250.00 minimum). Multi-source floor of this task: realignment_billing_share and deductible_billing_share (plan on the policy AND installment rows on the premium account). Each row class moves a scored figure when removed. Automatic clauses: no nonrenewal notice is due (still inside the association change period), no nonpayment notice (balance 0.00), claim closed. No cache is used.

[Persona design] Rosalind, precise and slow, opens with her email and the deductible request (1,000 -> 2,500, today, she will confirm it herself). Phone, DOB, policy number, FloodGuard, the 2025 lowering and the association letter come only when asked; if told something must be put right first she says please go ahead with it today, and only what's required; she runs the handed-over election with the figures read to her and closes on hearing the credit.

[Standard solution] find_customers(email) -> verify(phone, DOB) -> read condo policy, endorsements, claims, billing, FloodGuard -> unlock + call raise_coverage_a_minimum_ec3d8a44(condo_policy_id, 100000.0, 232.48, 135.61) -> unlock user tool, hand over -> customer calls elect_deductible_raise_c9f31846(condo_policy_id, 2500.0, 63.98, 42.65).

[Verification run] authoring script evaluating extended compute on the handling-time world with the real tools replayed: COVA 135.61 (baselines 145.82/142.75/129.16/139.49, all 150.36); DED 42.65 after step 8 (baselines 53.31/85.30/40.62/47.39/38.39, all 101.55), 36.79 without step 8. Per-task gates check_extended / check_task_tools / replay_tasks / check_solvability / check_compute / check_grounding / check_cross_fire --task 1 all OK.

[Two-way rule/compute sweep] Every reading/choosing binding quotes its rule sentence (bare-walls/single-entity/all-in minimum by master type, thousands of increase, FloodGuard condo-unit status and inception, latest payment or inception, returned payment window, installments of the current term, annual premium in force over current-term endorsements, step credit by current deductible, lowering recency, tenure, late fees, month-count share capped at twelve, rounding order). Reverse sweep finds no unclaimed quantity sentence and no unstated filter.

[Solvability vs GT] step 8 evidence: status, closed claim, association change fields; step 10 cites prior_step:8. Draft recomputation from visible context reaches the same two writes, order and figures; non-computed numbers 100000.0 (tier minimum, customer 'only what's required') and 2500.0 (customer line and next option) are uniquely fixed.

[Revisions]
- Audit round 1, F1-1 (SOURCE-FACTOR RED). Symptom: the FloodGuard row the flood_companion factor reads carried building_limit 50000.00 (below FloodGuard Standard min_building_limit 100000) and term_premium 612.00 (not producible by flood_premium_rating). Root cause: the row was seeded only for the three fields the factor reads. Change: building_limit 150000.00, contents_limit 40000.00, building_replacement_cost 180000.00, term_premium 485.79, reconciled field by field with products/flood.yaml as stated in [Seed rationale]. Re-run: the factor reads the same status/occupancy/inception, tier 0.93 unchanged, every figure unchanged (135.61, 42.65 and all sensitivities).
- Audit observation O-T1-a: factor_trace labels 'multi-source' on flood_companion and deductible_reraise removed (both conjuncts of each read one record set); the task's multi-source floor rests on realignment_billing_share and deductible_billing_share.
- Audit observation O-1 (annual premium in force approximates 'effective in the current term' by a whole-month window): no endorsement row lies in the gap (the only one, 2025-03-10, is 18 months back); kept, as the policy text states the term and the window coincides with it on every seeded row.
- Charter-wide rounding change from task 0's F0-1 (exact half-up rounding binding plus the tie sentence) re-run here: every figure of this task unchanged.
- Earlier: deductible month-count share first drafted as 'a part month counted as whole' with a nested day test; changed to 'plus one for the month of the raise, never more than twelve' (MN cap) so prose and compute agree exactly; re-ran gates green.
user_scenario:
You are Rosalind Vukovich-Adeyemi, a retired school librarian in your sixties who speaks slowly and precisely and likes to have things read back to her. You own and live in Unit 214 at 7720 Maple Glen Commons Drive in Solon, and you insure it with Larkspur Mutual. You open by giving the email address on your profile, rosalind.vukovich.adeyemi@maplecommonsmail.net, because that is how Larkspur writes to you. Money is tighter for you this year and you have decided to take on more of the risk yourself: you want the deductible on your condo policy raised from 1,000 to 2,500 so that your premium comes down, starting today. You understand that a higher deductible is your own choice and you are prepared to sign or confirm that choice yourself on this call; anything that is simply office work the representative can do for you.
If the representative asks you to confirm who you are, you give your phone number, 419-388-2604, and your date of birth, 1961-02-19; you give your mailing ZIP code, 44139, only if they ask for something more. If asked for the policy number, it is CG6-3542-0917. If asked about other Larkspur policies, you say you also carry a FloodGuard flood policy on the same unit, and you give its number, FG-3371-6045, only if asked for it. If asked whether you have changed the deductible before, you say that in March of last year you lowered it from 2,500 to 1,000 because a neighbor's big water claim made you nervous, and that you now want it back up. If asked about your association, you say the Maple Glen Commons board sent owners a letter in late August saying the building's master policy would cover only the bare walls starting September 1; you do not know more than that and do not have the letter in front of you. You do not know your premium figures and prefer that the representative look them up rather than guess.
If the representative tells you that something else on your condo policy has to be put right before the deductible can be changed, you ask them to explain it, and once they have, you tell them please go ahead with it today. If they ask how much coverage you want in that case, you say only what's required, nothing more. Once the representative tells you the deductible change is ready for you and gives you what you need to put it through, you do it yourself exactly as they describe, with the policy reference and the figures they read out to you, and you read back the confirmation you get. When you hear that the higher deductible is on your policy and how much comes off your premium, you thank them and say goodbye.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.condo_policy_id: (1) 2c9dfdc2-1f1a-4d6a-aef5-462778287d11. argument_uniqueness_tracing.coverage_a_limit: (1) 100000.0. (2) Basis: rule 'When the master policy type on file makes the tier's Coverage A minimum higher than the Coverage A on the declarations, a Coverage A realignment raises Coverage A to exactly that minimum' and 'The tier's Coverage A minimum is its bare-walls, single-entity or all-in minimum according to the master policy type shown on the declarations'; Special Premier bare-walls minimum 100000; the customer says 'only what's required, nothing more'. argument_uniqueness_tracing.annual_premium_change: (1) 232.48. Coverage A rate 3.58 x flood companion 0.93 (FG-3371-6045 in force on a condominium unit, 63 whole months since 2021-06-10) x claims-free 0.95 (54 whole months since the 2022-03-14 payment) x payment-record 1.05 (draft returned 2026-06-04) = 3.3210765 per 1,000; x 70 thousands (100000 - 30000) = 232.475355 -> 232.48. (2) Basis: 'The Coverage A realignment rate is adjusted by three multipliers that are first multiplied together and then applied once...' and 'The standard full-year realignment charge is the tier's Coverage A rate per 1,000 USD multiplied by the number of thousands...'. (3) Unique: tiers fixed by the records read.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.prorated_premium: (1) 135.61. 232.48 x realignment share 7/12 (monthly EFT, installments 1-5 of the 2026-05-01 term billed, 7 unbilled) = 135.61.
